statusDetail: Coverage-complete representative audit. Search and product-detail paths returned repeatable eBay error pages; those observed failures are judged as issues rather than hidden as blocked audit work.

page.framework: Server-rendered Marko-like templates with client enhancement (framework not conclusively fingerprinted)
page.notes: Public UK marketplace. Representative home and category templates rendered; search and item-detail routes failed in fresh sessions. Checkout, signed-in account management, payment, listing creation and post-consent personalization were not covered because they require state, credentials or commitments.

paths.description: Homepage entry, global navigation, discovery content, consent, metadata, performance, security and repeated menu interaction.
Mobile first viewport and responsive global header/consent state.
Electronics category template representing browse/listing taxonomy and entity metadata.
Primary search journey for “laptop”; fresh session returned a generic eBay error.
Representative promoted item-detail journey; fresh session returned a generic eBay error.

findings.summary: The homepage remains light when the user requests a dark colour scheme.
findings.evidence: The prefers-color-scheme: dark screenshot is visually identical to the light capture, with white page chrome and surfaces. CSS contains a colour-scheme signal, but it does not produce a usable dark presentation.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply the dark-mode guidance to surface, text, border, icon and form tokens, declare color-scheme, and verify all templates under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

findings.summary: The initial cookie banner obscures most of the mobile first viewport and much of the desktop content.
findings.evidence: At 360x800 the fixed blue consent surface covers the content from about y=178 to the bottom, leaving only the header and a fragment of the hero visible. The desktop capture also devotes roughly 300px of 493px to it.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact, content-preserving consent surface with equal Accept, Decline and Customize choices; reserve a full dialog only when legally necessary and restore focus after dismissal.

findings.summary: Many navigation controls have touch targets substantially below modern target-size guidance.
findings.evidence: The DOM probe found numerous visible links and menu buttons only 13–22 CSS px high, plus a 20x32 message target. Programmatic focus also showed no outline on the search input, although keyboard :focus-visible was not separately captured.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase interactive hit areas to at least 24x24 CSS px and preferably 44x44 for primary mobile controls, preserve spacing, and verify a visible :focus-visible style with a real keyboard focus walk.

findings.summary: Representative search and product-detail journeys terminate in a generic server error.
findings.evidence: Fresh navigations to a search results URL and a product URL both rendered “SORRY, Something went wrong on our end” instead of results or item content. The only action is Go to homepage; there is no Retry control.
findings.suggestedFix: Make bot/risk handling distinguish abusive automation from ordinary browser sessions, preserve the attempted destination, and offer a working retry path with a stable incident reference.

findings.summary: The homepage misses the good loading and responsiveness ranges by a wide margin.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 12.0s, FCP 3.7s, TBT 1,020ms and TTI 21.6s (performance score 0.40). The first-party trace corroborated a 5.11s LCP and four long tasks.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the LCP dependency chain, prioritize the true LCP asset, split long tasks, defer non-critical modules, and remeasure on mobile until LCP and interaction work are in the good range.

findings.summary: The initial page ships a heavy resource graph with avoidable image and script cost.
findings.evidence: The HAR recorded 110 requests and 3,028,724 transferred bytes: 1.46MB images and 1.22MB scripts. It identified parser-inserted high-priority resources and several individual scripts/images above 100KB.
findings.suggestedFix: Shorten critical dependency chains, defer non-critical scripts, set deliberate image fetch priority, and deliver responsive image candidates sized to their display slots.

findings.summary: The mobile accessibility tree contains focusable controls hidden from assistive technology and lacks a main landmark in the audited state.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse/axe reported aria-hidden-focus failures in the mobile header, search field, search button and keyboard trap boundaries, plus landmark-one-main. Accessibility score was 0.94, so these are specific structural defects rather than a blanket failure.
findings.suggestedFix: Never leave focusable descendants under aria-hidden=true; disable/remove them from tab order while hidden. Ensure exactly one exposed main landmark in every responsive DOM state.

findings.summary: Thirty rendered images have no alt attribute in the homepage image inventory.
findings.evidence: The images primitive inspected 80 images and reported missingAlt=30. Some appear decorative or duplicated clickable imagery, but they still need explicit empty alt when decorative or meaningful text when informative.
findings.suggestedFix: Classify every image: provide concise meaningful alt for informative images and alt="" for decorative images, while ensuring linked image names remain discernible.

findings.summary: Deprecated unload handling blocks BFCache, and production diagnostics include missing source maps.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found an unload event listener in discoveryplatformweb JS, confirmed BFCache was blocked by an unload handler, and reported missing/404 source maps for large first-party scripts.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unload listeners in favor of pagehide/visibilitychange where needed, test BFCache restoration, and publish correct production source maps under an intentional access policy.

findings.summary: The non-JavaScript crawler fetch receives an anti-bot challenge shell with almost none of the public page content or metadata.
findings.evidence: Discoverability captures for home and category returned HTTP 200 challenge HTML with only 2% content coverage; title, h1 and meta description were absent from raw HTML. The browser eventually rendered the pages, while robots.txt explicitly restricts automated access.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve stable server-rendered title, description, headings and core public content to permitted crawlers, and use explicit 4xx challenge responses rather than a 200 shell when access is denied.

findings.summary: The main document lacks an enforced CSP and several defensive headers, while numerous cookies are not marked Secure.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive found no enforced Content-Security-Policy, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy. The cookie audit found 24 cookies, with many __uz*/bm_* cookies lacking Secure and all reported SameSite=None; no client-side sensitive secret was detected.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy an enforced nonce/hash-based CSP, add a restrictive Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy, and mark all HTTPS cookies Secure with the narrowest viable SameSite and HttpOnly settings.

findings.summary: Responsive image delivery wastes bytes despite using modern WebP assets.
findings.evidence: Of 80 images, 31 were more than 2x their displayed width, 51 lacked srcset, 79 lacked width/height attributes and 22 below-fold images were not lazy-loaded. The HAR transferred 1.46MB of images.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate width-based WebP/AVIF candidates, add sizes/srcset and intrinsic dimensions, lazy-load below-fold content, and avoid fetching 960px assets into ~245px slots.

findings.summary: The commerce surface is intentionally closed to browser agents and exposes no page-level structured agent capability.
findings.evidence: robots.txt explicitly prohibits LLM-driven and buy-for-me checkout agents and directs approved integrations to the external API. The discoverability probe received a challenge shell, and the DOM probe found no WebMCP/agentic capability surface.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep checkout human-reviewed, but expose narrowly scoped read-only or reversible WebMCP/agentic form tools for search, item inspection and saved-list actions, backed by the approved API and explicit consent.

findings.summary: Most image elements omit intrinsic width and height.
findings.evidence: The image inventory reported 79 of 80 images without width/height attributes. Observed CLS was currently low (0.019–0.022), but intrinsic dimensions remain missing and increase instability risk across dynamic content.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width and height attributes or an equivalent intrinsic aspect ratio for every image candidate while retaining responsive CSS sizing.

findings.summary: The generic failure state does not preserve context or offer an actionable retry.
findings.evidence: Both failed primary paths show an opaque incident code and only “Go to homepage”. The attempted query/item and a Retry action are absent, forcing users to restart.
findings.suggestedFix: Explain the temporary state in plain language, preserve the attempted destination, add Retry and Back controls, and avoid discarding the user’s query or item context.

findings.summary: Core public content is not present in the raw response delivered to the audit crawler.
findings.evidence: The no-JavaScript/raw comparison found 2% content coverage and no title, h1 or meta description for both home and category; browser rendering required passing a challenge and JavaScript navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Return meaningful server-rendered core content and metadata before enhancement, then layer challenge and personalization behavior without replacing the document with an empty 200 shell.

findings.summary: Search and item failures collapse into a non-recoverable generic page.
findings.evidence: Two distinct routes produced the same generic error with no retry, no preserved query/item context and no alternative route besides the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide route-specific failure states with retry, retained state, support context and safe fallback content instead of replacing the whole journey.

findings.summary: The unauthenticated commercial journey could not reach item or checkout information in the representative browser session.
findings.evidence: The product detail route failed before pricing, seller terms, purchase controls or cancellation/commitment information could be inspected. This is a task-level trust failure for the tested session, not a judgement on unobserved checkout UI.
findings.suggestedFix: Ensure ordinary browser sessions can inspect item and commitment details before authentication, and provide a recoverable risk challenge rather than a generic dead end.

taskList.title: Restore reliable, recoverable search and item-detail journeys
Bring LCP and main-thread work into the good range
Enforce CSP and tighten defensive headers and cookie flags
Serve meaningful public content and metadata to permitted non-JS crawlers
Reduce the first-load consent banner footprint
Fix responsive accessibility tree and landmark exposure
Deliver correctly sized responsive images with intrinsic dimensions
Add a complete system-driven dark theme
Increase small hit targets and verify keyboard focus-visible
Remove unload/BFCache blockers and repair diagnostics
Offer safe structured read-only agent capabilities

checkOutcomes.method: Dark and light screenshot comparison plus CSS signal probe.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Dark emulation leaves the white light presentation unchanged.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated prefers-reduced-motion and queried document.getAnimations().
checkOutcomes.evidence: The reduced-motion condition matched and active animation count was 0 after load.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured prefers-contrast: more and checked Lighthouse contrast.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Text and controls remain visible in the high-contrast capture; Lighthouse color-contrast passed.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected loaded CSS rules for view-transition usage.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The CSS probe found authored view-transition rules on the interactive homepage.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected loaded CSS for animation-timeline/scroll-timeline.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The CSS probe found declarative scroll-timeline signals rather than relying only on scroll event evidence.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected loaded CSS for scroll snapping and reduced-motion behavior.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The homepage CSS includes scroll-snap behavior and suppresses animations under reduced motion.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected CSS scroll-state/scroll-timeline signals and desktop/mobile screenshots.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Responsive navigation remains oriented and loaded CSS contains declarative scroll timeline/state features.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected loaded CSS for anchor positioning.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The CSS probe found anchor-name/position-anchor usage for positioned UI.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed heading/navigation hierarchy and CSS view-transition/scroll-snap signals.
checkOutcomes.evidence: A skip link, descriptive route links, strong section hierarchy and declarative transition/snap signals guide navigation.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared first-load screenshots at desktop and 360x800.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The consent banner obscures most of the mobile viewport and a majority of desktop content.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected overlays and consent controls in DOM/screenshot.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Overlay states expose dialog semantics and the consent surface has visible Accept, Decline, Customize and close controls.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed first viewport content-to-chrome ratio.
checkOutcomes.evidence: On first visit consent chrome dominates the viewport instead of the marketplace content.

checkOutcomes.method: Measured layout at 360x800 on home and product/error templates.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Home reported scrollWidth=clientWidth=360, viewport meta present, overflow 0; error template also fit 360px.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected CSS and compared desktop/mobile screenshots.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Loaded CSS contains container-query signals and header/hero composition adapts materially at 360px.

checkOutcomes.method: Measured visible interactive rectangles and sampled focus styles.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Many navigation targets are only 13–22px high; the search input focus sample had no outline.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed homepage and category first viewports, headings and primary controls.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The eBay purpose, search field, category heading and Sell/marketplace actions are immediately identifiable.

checkOutcomes.method: Navigated representative search and product-detail paths in fresh browser sessions.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Both primary paths returned generic eBay error pages instead of results/detail content.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected the failed search and product states.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The state says something went wrong but offers only homepage navigation, not retry or preserved context.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse plus a first-party CDP trace and mobile layout observer.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse LCP=12.0s, TBT=1020ms; trace LCP=5.11s with four long tasks.

checkOutcomes.method: Measured layout shifts with layout observer and Lighthouse.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Mobile layout CLS was 0.0194 and Lighthouse CLS 0.0218, both in the good range.

checkOutcomes.method: Measured long tasks and blocking time via trace/Lighthouse.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse TBT was 1,020ms and trace found four 66–89ms long tasks.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured HAR, read compact summary, and inspected image delivery.
checkOutcomes.evidence: 110 requests transferred 3.03MB with 1.22MB script and 1.46MB images; high-priority parser chains were present.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed HAR script cost and Lighthouse diagnostics.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Thirty-eight scripts transferred 1.22MB, with individual bundles at 326KB and 289KB; this dominates an already slow load.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse accessibility audits, DOM form probe and image inventory.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Controls/forms were generally named, but 30 of 80 image elements lacked alt attributes.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse color-contrast and reviewed high-contrast screenshot.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse color-contrast passed and text/control boundaries remain legible under prefers-contrast: more.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse/axe structural checks and DOM focus/landmark probes.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The mobile audited state has aria-hidden containers with focusable descendants and no exposed main landmark.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed desktop/mobile screenshots and heading hierarchy.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Body and heading text is readable, unclipped and consistently aligned at both viewports.

checkOutcomes.method: Checked viewport zoom policy, 360px reflow, target rectangles and media elements.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Zoom/reflow passed and autoplay was off, but many visible targets were only 13–22px high.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse best-practices console audit.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Console security errors reported ignored upgrade-insecure-requests directives in report-only CSP.

checkOutcomes.method: Probed doctype/charset and ran image inventory.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Doctype html and UTF-8 are valid, but 79 of 80 images omit intrinsic dimensions.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse deprecation, BFCache and source-map diagnostics.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Unload listeners are deprecated and block BFCache; large first-party source maps are missing or 404.

checkOutcomes.method: Read rendered DOM metadata on home and category.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Both templates have unique descriptive titles and meta descriptions.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse SEO, inspected links/viewport and fetched robots.txt.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse SEO passed; all 375 sampled anchors had href, viewport meta allows scaling, and robots.txt is syntactically valid.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared raw crawler fetch to rendered DOM and checked canonical/hreflang/robots/sitemap.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Canonical and 44 hreflang links exist rendered, but raw crawler HTML is a 200 challenge shell with 2% content and no title/h1/description.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected Open Graph and JSON-LD on representative templates.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Homepage has six Open Graph tags; category has six Open Graph tags and one JSON-LD block matching the Electronics entity.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran headers, cookies, secrets and HAR primitives.
checkOutcomes.evidence: HTTPS/HSTS/nosniff/frame protection pass, but enforced CSP is absent and many cookies lack Secure.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured pre-consent tracker inventory and HAR origin/byte summary.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No known tracker domain was observed before consent; visible consent offers equal Decline and Customize choices. Most cross-origin bytes are eBay CDN assets.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected first-load UI/Lighthouse for permission prompts and authentication entry points.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No geolocation/notification permission prompt appeared on load; sign-in is user initiated. Auth internals were not exercised.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected main-document defensive headers and cookie posture.
checkOutcomes.evidence: HSTS and SAMEORIGIN are present, but CSP, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are absent and cookie flags are overly broad.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran raw-HTML/no-JS discoverability comparisons on home and category.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Both raw responses expose only 2% of rendered content and omit title, h1 and description.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared responsive overlays/menu CSS and exercised the My eBay menu repeatedly.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No DOM-count growth or clipped responsive chrome was observed during ten menu toggles; anchor/container CSS signals are present.

checkOutcomes.method: Judged against commerce-site context and DOM manifest/service-worker probe.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Buying, live inventory and account operations are intrinsically online; offline transaction completion is not a meaningful expectation for this audited public surface.
checkOutcomes.reason: Buying, live inventory and account operations are intrinsically online; offline transaction completion is not a meaningful expectation for this audited public surface.

checkOutcomes.method: Navigated search and product URLs that failed in fresh sessions.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Both failures replace the flow with a generic page lacking retry and retained context.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected html language, hreflang and CSS logical-property signals.
checkOutcomes.evidence: html lang=en-GB, 44 hreflang alternatives and logical inline/block CSS signals support localized layouts.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed localized UK metadata/content and alternate-locale declarations.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The audited UK template uses en-GB, £ pricing language and extensive hreflang routing rather than locale-neutral copy.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed representative static home/category and inaccessible item/search paths for time-zone-sensitive task data.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No user-entered or commitment-critical date/time flow was reachable in the audited public templates, so time-zone arithmetic could not meaningfully apply.
checkOutcomes.reason: No user-entered or commitment-critical date/time flow was reachable in the audited public templates, so time-zone arithmetic could not meaningfully apply.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed consent and marketplace first-load screenshots.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Consent provides equally prominent Accept all and Decline all plus customization; no confirmshaming or preselected paid continuity was observed.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed generic error states reached from search and product navigation.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The failures explain neither recovery timing nor how to retry, and discard useful task context.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected homepage forms, labels and autocomplete attributes.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Search controls are labelled and use an appropriate search-specific autocomplete-off posture; no address/payment form was exposed on audited routes.

checkOutcomes.method: Attempted representative product-detail journey before authentication.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The product route failed before users could inspect price, commitment or purchase controls.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran image inventory and HAR byte accounting.
checkOutcomes.evidence: 31 images are oversized, 51 lack srcset and image transfer totals 1.46MB.

checkOutcomes.method: Measured long tasks, request count and background/cross-origin activity during load.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page makes 110 requests and executes 38 scripts with 1,020ms TBT, indicating disproportionate load work before interaction.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed HAR origin budget and media/image behavior.
checkOutcomes.evidence: 91 cross-origin requests transfer 2.34MB, mostly eBay CDNs; 1.46MB of imagery includes oversized assets. Video elements did not autoplay.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected robots policy, raw crawler response and DOM capability signals.
checkOutcomes.evidence: LLM/buy-for-me agents are explicitly prohibited and challenged; approved integrations are redirected to an external API, with no page-level WebMCP surface.

checkOutcomes.method: Judged the representative commerce templates for a concrete on-device inference need.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Search, browsing and purchase inspection do not require an on-device language model or summarizer to remain usable; absence is not a defect.
checkOutcomes.reason: Search, browsing and purchase inspection do not require an on-device language model or summarizer to remain usable; absence is not a defect.

checkOutcomes.method: Repeated My eBay menu open/close ten times and compared DOM/JS heap samples.
checkOutcomes.evidence: DOM element count stayed 2,624; usedJSHeapSize rose about 1.83MB during the bounded exercise with no continuing sample trend established.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured heap summary and compared against page complexity and network footprint.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Baseline heap summary was 539,383 nodes and 46.8MB self size. This is substantial but proportionate to the content-rich marketplace homepage in the captured state.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared stable live DOM count across repeated menu toggles and inspected heap constructor summaries.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The repeated interaction left the live DOM count unchanged and heap summaries did not surface a Detached* constructor among dominant populations.
